description: This file defines a React component called AppLayout, which structures the main layout of a web application with a fixed sidebar, a topbar, and a content area. It imports other components such as Topbar, Sidebar, and PageTransition, and composes them into a cohesive layout using JSX.

methods.name: AppLayout({ children })
methods.description: A React functional component that renders the application layout with a fixed sidebar, topbar, and main content area, wrapping children components inside a layout structure.
